patch_description:
The current approach uses a greedy multicast-tree expansion, varying only the first destination seed. Its key configuration is an implicit single-pass greedy selection that can miss a globally cheaper shared relay/trunk.

This version uses an exact directed-Steiner dynamic program for up to 11 unique reachable destinations (`EXACT_TERMINAL_LIMIT = 11`). The DP evaluates all destination subsets and all possible relay nodes, allowing multiple destination branches to merge at low-cost intermediate clouds before being connected to the source. This reduces redundant source-side transfers and finds globally optimal shared broadcast trees on typical multi-cloud destination sets.

For larger sets, it falls back to a deterministic shared-aware greedy attachment strategy with zero marginal cost for already-installed broadcast edges. Invalid, missing, negative, and non-finite costs are excluded safely. All partitions retain the same selected shared tree paths, allowing parallel partition transfer over the chosen multi-network topology.
